caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass vessel with a slightly flared rim. The glass features an intricate, broad, light blue decorative pattern across its upper section, including symmetrical floral and scroll motifs centered around a stylized plant in a vase. The lower section of the vessel displays clear semicircular shapes. Below the main illustration, there is a simple line drawing of the glass's bottom view, showing a circular and geometric flower-plan design. The drawing’s background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist’s signature “ESchwabe” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Stiegel Water Tumbler
